description: MTA Subway Turnstile Usage Data is a series of datasets listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This retired dataset contains information on entry/exit values for individual control areas and is posted purely for archival purposes. More detailed subway ridership data is now supported through the Subway hourly dataset (. Coverage: New York State. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are ridership, airtrain, airtrain jfk, customers, fares. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2016-01-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
